title: ALINA production avatar integration
goal: Replace placeholder-only ALINA presence with a stateful renderer-adapter integration that preserves persona state and degrades safely across product scenarios and performance tiers.
why: ALINA must be a reusable digital specialist presence, not markup tied to one screen or one future 3D renderer.
constraints: persona/task state must not live in renderer objects
Core tier must remain usable without WebGL
reduced motion must disable decorative avatar motion
cinematic missing capabilities must be visible rather than silently claimed
deliverables: activity state integration with command plane
Playwright avatar interaction and fallback proof
acceptanceCriteria: Presentation requests hologram and exposes degraded proxy if 3D capability is absent
Core tier resolves Presentation to portrait
Focus mode remains hidden with state retained
command focus/listen and submit/speak states are visible
renderer can change without changing persona state
